## How did you test it?

- [ ] The launcher test passes (`node tests/e2e.mjs`), or the change does not touch the program.
- [ ] For a change to a case, to `systemPrompt()`, or to the model: a bench run (`python3 bench/eval.py`).
- [ ] Each changed case keeps its credit and says what was changed.
- [ ] No new network request, dependency, or build step.
- [ ] A line in CHANGELOG.md, if a learner will notice the change.
